title: Unauthorized Transaction, Phishing and Fraud Escalation Policy
content: Any caller reporting unauthorized debits, stolen credentials, phishing, scam calls, or account takeover must be escalated immediately to a live fraud response specialist. Zero-liability protection under RBI guidelines applies when unauthorized electronic transactions are reported promptly within 3 working days. Bank representatives never ask customers to share OTPs, passwords, PINs, CVV codes, or remote screen-sharing access.
